surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
evidence: Goldstein et al. 29 reported that TMA can undergo ligand change reactions with Al(hfac)* surface species: 3AlðhfacÞ/C3 þ AlðCH3Þ3 f AlðhfacÞ3 þ 3AlðCH3Þ/C3 (1).
